content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overshoot true outcomes by 5-10% during bearish regimes, requiring a downward correction factor.", "Sentiment spikes above 0.8 often precede immediate price drops rather than sustained rallies in this dataset.", "The model exhibits significant mean-reversion bias toward historical averages when sentiment is neutral or low.", "Forecast accuracy degrades sharply when sentiment history shows conflicting signals between high and low values.", "Apply a 15% reduction to the first week's forecast projection when recent history indicates downward momentum.", "Ignore positive sentiment forecasts if the last three days of history show declining prices despite rising sentiment scores.", "The model systematically underestimates volatility during periods where sentiment remains consistently above 0.67.", "Correct upward forecasts by subtracting the average daily decline observed in the preceding 18-day history window."] }
